name: Tekmos

about:
Tekmos, Inc. is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Founded in 1997 as a spin-off of Flextronics Semiconductor, the company began as a contract design center handling FPGA conversions and large FPGA-based systems for on-demand cable providers.

Today Tekmos designs and manufactures custom analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, including ASICs, FPGAs, microprocessors, flash memories, and high-temperature chips. The company leverages SOI CMOS processes for operation up to 300°C and bulk silicon up to 200°C, and offers stacked die packaging that combines up to nine different chips in a single package. With over 900 completed designs, Tekmos serves hundreds of customers worldwide, delivering volumes from prototype to over 100,000 units annually for individual part numbers.

The company serves consumer electronics, aerospace, automotive, defense, industrial, medical, oil and gas, and telecommunications markets. Concrete examples include supplying replacement processors for grounded military aircraft, high-temperature ASICs for downhole drilling steering, chips for fitness wearables and oral medical devices, and 60,000 emergency units to restore telephone service in New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina. Tekmos also recreated obsolete telecom ASICs for Lucent switches after Agere end-of-lifed the original parts.

Tekmos positions itself as a bridge between standard components and finished products, emphasizing low development risk, low cost, and fast time to market. Its differentiators include full military lot qualification (MIL-STD-883 and MIL-PRF-38535 flows), ITAR registration, AS9100D certification, and the ability to reverse-engineer legacy parts into modern, manufacturable designs.
